latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the Privacy Solution Scorecard skill.

- Evaluate and compare privacy management vendors across 12 weighted criteria, including functionality, compliance, cost, and stability.
- Interactive workflow to gather organizational context, priorities, and detailed vendor scores.
- Returns detailed scorecards, side-by-side comparison matrix, tailored recommendations, and an executive summary.
- Supports comparisons of major vendors (OneTrust, BigID, TrustArc, Securiti, etc.) for RFPs, platform selection, or business cases.
- Requires TOOLWEB_API_KEY and curl; outputs follow a clear board-ready report template.
- Built by a CISSP/CISM certified security professional; integrates with https://portal.toolweb.in
